info.title: Straits.live Hormuz monitor
info.description: Locally curated request catalog for x402 MCP. Not a vendor-published OpenAPI document.

get.summary: AI-assisted daily situation brief as structured JSON, by date or latest

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the latest brief
parameters.name: date

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Bunker & marine-fuel prices ($/tonne): current VLSFO/IFO380/MGO for Fujairah, Singapore, Rotterdam, plus the derived Fujairah premium over each benchmark hub

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Bulk history export: index-5min, stranded, and ais-gaps cap at 365 days of retained history; transits returns its full retained history instead

parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of index-5min, stranded, ais-gaps, transits; omit for all
parameters.name: feeds

parameters.description: json (default) or csv for a multi-section download
parameters.name: format

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Historical series: stranded and AIS-gap counts (hourly, capped at one year, growing), 5-min index, daily transits

parameters.description: index-5min: both Hormuz indices at 5-minute cadence. transits: complete daily IMF PortWatch history, enriched per day with the 7-day moving average, pre-crisis-baseline deviation, and reopening-threshold headroom. stranded: hourly stranded-vessel counts, up to a year. ais-gaps: hourly AIS-dark counts, up to a year.
parameters.name: feed

parameters.description: index-5min only: window in days, 1-30 (default 7)
parameters.name: days

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Hormuz flag rollup: live-AIS vessel population by flag state, with per-flag sanctioned tallies

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Shadow-fleet risk screen: the live-AIS vessel population ranked worst-first, each hull with its risk band, typed reasons, and sanctions-body matches (flagged hulls by default; ?all=1 for every screened hull)

parameters.description: Set to 1 to include the cleared low-band hulls; default returns only the flagged hulls (high + moderate). counts always cover the screened population, that is every hull seen on AIS inside the active window.
parameters.name: all

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: War-risk transit premium nowcast: a live modeled war-risk insurance multiple (Nx over the peace baseline, 1x-80x scale) for the strait, recomputed every 5 minutes from throughput, escalation, OVX, and event signals, with the standing straits.live insurance-estimate multiple carried as a static reference

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: One-call snapshot: everything the Strait of Hormuz crisis monitor knows

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Single-vessel sanctions + risk dossier by IMO: unified multi-body (OFAC + UK) sanctions, identity, risk band, dark-activity

parameters.description: 7-digit IMO number of the vessel
parameters.name: imo

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Per-vessel intelligence: live-AIS manifest, sanctioned-in-strait, risk bands, raw AIS positions

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.summary: Hormuz Index: Crisis Pressure and Escalation Forecast composites
get.description: The two 0-100 Hormuz Index composites - Crisis Pressure (current state) and Escalation Forecast (30-day outlook) - with bands and per-component breakdowns. Recomputed every 5 minutes.

parameters.description: Opt-in time series nested at indices.<name>.history (30d resolves to daily points from the historical rollup, the rest to the raw 5-minute series).
parameters.name: history

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Rolling Brent and WTI prices from intraday front-month futures contracts (Yahoo Finance chart data, continuous quotes as fallback, EIA daily backstop). Underlying feed every 10 minutes; not edge-cached.

parameters.description: Point count (default 168 = about 7 days hourly, max 2000).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only points at or after this ISO timestamp.
parameters.name: since

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Count of tankers that were broadcasting in the chokepoint core and went silent for 3-24 hours, plus the 7-day baseline. Computed every 30 minutes. Per-vessel dark-fleet identities are premium data.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Indexed strikes, ship incidents, closures, and negotiations with source attribution - GDELT auto-pull every 15 minutes plus hand-curated events.

parameters.description: Only events at or after this ISO timestamp.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Filter to one event type.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Max events returned.
parameters.name: limit

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Top Hormuz / Iran-conflict / oil-shock contracts from Kalshi and Polymarket, strict keyword-filtered. Underlying feed every 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Max markets returned.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter to one venue.
parameters.name: venue

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Per-state regular-grade averages plus a national mean across the 50 states plus DC (AAA). Refreshed hourly; upstream publishes daily.

parameters.description: Set to 1 to include the per-state list (default omitted for payload size).
parameters.name: states

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: The dashboard's authoritative daily transit count with per-type breakdown (tanker, cargo, container, dry bulk, general cargo, Ro-Ro), capacity in DWT, trailing 30-day baseline median, and the fixed pre-crisis baseline (2025-02-28 to 2026-02-27). nCargo is nContainer plus nDryBulk plus nGeneralCargo plus nRoro - summing all seven fields double-counts.

parameters.description: Set to 1 to include chokepointTransitsHistory rows.
parameters.name: history

parameters.description: History rows to return.
parameters.name: limit

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Side-by-side daily counts for Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, Suez, the Cape of Good Hope, and Malacca (IMF PortWatch), sorted Hormuz first then by nTotal descending.

parameters.description: Set to 1 to include per-chokepoint daily history[].
parameters.name: history

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Live vessel counts at Fujairah, Sohar, Bandar Abbas, and Jebel Ali from AIS positions inside a 10-18 km radius per port, by status (anchored, transiting) and vessel type. Computed every 30 minutes.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Anchored-vessel count inside the Persian Gulf bounding box, hourly buckets written every 30 minutes. Powers the homepage sparkline.

parameters.description: Hourly buckets (default 168 = 7 days, max 720).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only buckets at or after this ISO timestamp.
parameters.name: since

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Hourly cross-tab of vessels in transit by type (tanker, cargo, military, other); the military count is a floor - the response's methodology field explains how type is resolved.

parameters.description: Hourly buckets (default 168 = 7 days, max 720).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only buckets at or after this ISO timestamp.
parameters.name: since

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Count of vessels visible on AIS in the Persian Gulf window whose identity matches an OFAC SDN entry (IMO / normalised-name join; false positives possible). Cross-join every 15 minutes; per-vessel detail is premium data.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Multiple over the peace-baseline VLCC premium, per-voyage cost in USD from peacetime baseline to current crisis high, and the P&I clubs / war-risk underwriters that have withdrawn cover, imposed quotas, or refused renewals. Hand-curated; timestamp refreshed weekly.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: EIA/IEA shares of global seaborne oil and LNG transiting the strait, a curated daily economic-cost estimate, the most-affected importing economies, and extra Cape-reroute voyage days. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Marine war-risk high-risk areas from the Lloyd's Joint War Committee circular, plus a flag for whether the latest revision mentions the Arabian Gulf. Drives war-risk premium loads at most London-market underwriters. Re-checked every 6 hours.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Top container carriers by TEU capacity and their Hormuz posture (suspended, rerouting, limited, transiting), vessels-trapped count, trapped TEU, and per-carrier surcharge in USD per TEU. hormuzPosture is the operative field: 5+ carriers stopped within 60-day advisories drives the 'effectively closed' verdict. Hand-curated; refreshed weekly.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Petroline (Saudi Arabia to Yanbu) and Habshan-Fujairah (UAE to Gulf of Oman) - the main crude routes out of the Gulf without transiting Hormuz - with nameplate capacity in BPD and current utilisation. Hand-curated.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Open-market USD/IRR sell/buy rates in Toman (1 Toman = 10 Rial) and Rial, plus 24-hour and 7-day percentage deltas off the midRial - a proxy for civilian-side financial stress inside Iran. Refreshed hourly.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: JSON archive of every daily brief: 3-6 bullets, a short summary, the day's Brent price plus 24-hour delta, and the day's transit count, keyed by UTC date. Rewritten every few hours.

parameters.description: A single UTC-dated brief (YYYY-MM-DD); 404 if missing.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Max briefs returned.
parameters.name: limit

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Bare-minimum payload for polling: Brent price, 24-hour change, transit and stranded counts, plus a verifiedAt anchor. 30-second edge cache.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Compares current state to a caller-provided anchor timestamp and raises a material flag once any of: 24h+ elapsed, Brent moved 1%+, any new event, any carrier posture change, transit delta 3+, or stranded delta 5+. 60-second edge cache.

parameters.description: Anchor ISO timestamp (required).
parameters.name: at

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: SPR stocks from the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report with the 4-week change so spike-vs-baseline reads correctly. Re-fetched daily 11:00 ET.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

get.description: Cushing, Oklahoma WTI-delivery-hub inventories from the EIA weekly report - tracks the North-American crude balance independently of the Gulf-Coast / SPR picture; pairs with the Brent-WTI spread. Re-fetched daily 11:30 ET.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.
